b1-unit-42.42.1 Gap Year Diaries: what do you say w:
Danny: Welcome back to Gap Year Diaries! I have big news today, and my friend Bruno is here to help me tell it. Hi Bruno!
Bruno: Hey Danny! What a week you've had!
Danny: You can say that again. So, on Thursday I had my job interview at the language school. When I was leaving the hostel, Mrs. Lima shouted "Good luck!" from the kitchen. And I said... "Same to you!"
Bruno: Same to you? She wasn't going to an interview!
Danny: I know! I was so nervous. You say "Same to you" when someone says "Have a nice weekend", not "Good luck". The right answer is just "Thanks!"
Bruno: And how did the interview go?
Danny: Well, it started badly. The director sneezed three times, and I said nothing! Back home, we always say "Bless you". I just froze.
Bruno: Ha! Maybe she didn't notice.
Danny: Then she put some coffee and cookies on the table and said "Help yourself". So I helped myself... to five cookies.
Bruno: Five cookies! How embarrassing!
Danny: But she laughed, and we talked for an hour. And on Friday morning they called me. I got the job!
Bruno: Congratulations again! You're going to be such a good teacher.
Danny: Thanks! On Friday night I had dinner with Ana to celebrate. She raised her glass and said "Cheers!", and I said "Cheers!" too. Finally, the right answer!
Bruno: What a relief! And did you settle the bill, like you promised?
Danny: I tried! I asked for the check, and the waiter said "Here you are". But Ana paid when I went to the restroom. How sneaky!
Bruno: That's Ana. But the week wasn't all good news, was it?
Danny: No. On Saturday morning Rafa called. His grandfather died. I didn't know what to say. My textbook says "My condolences", but it sounded so formal on the phone.
Bruno: Most people just say "I'm so sorry for your loss" or "I'm so sorry". And then you listen.
Danny: That's what I did. We didn't go to the beach, of course. Rafa said sorry about our trip, and I said "Never mind! We can go another time."
Bruno: Perfect. And on Monday I'm driving you to your first day at work. What will you say when you get in the car?
Danny: "Be careful!" Because you're a terrible driver.
Bruno: How rude! My dad is the terrible driver, not me!
Danny: OK, thanks for listening, everyone. Have a great week!
Bruno: Same to you!
b1-unit-42.42.2 Listen and respond: social expressi:
Narrator: I've got a new job!
Ana: Congratulations!
Narrator: Cheers!
Ana: Cheers!
Narrator: I'm going to climb onto the roof to fix the antenna.
Ana: Be careful!
Narrator: Sorry, we don't have time to visit the museum today.
Ana: Never mind. We can go another time.
Narrator: Can I have another piece of cake?
Ana: Sure, help yourself.
Narrator: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
Ana: Sure, here you are.
Narrator: Have a great vacation!
Ana: Thanks! Same to you.
Narrator: My grandmother died last week.
Ana: Oh no. I'm so sorry for your loss.
Narrator: I have a job interview this afternoon.
Ana: Good luck!
Narrator: Achoo! Sorry, I have a cold.
Ana: Bless you!
